description: This file defines a set of custom exception classes related to promotions, such as coupon not found, inactive coupon, currency mismatch, and invalid apply request. The exceptions are used for mapping errors within the promotions service layer.

classes.name: PromotionsExceptions
classes.description: A container class for various exception classes related to promotions management.

classes.name: CouponNotFoundException
classes.description: Thrown when a coupon with the specified code is not found.

classes.name: CouponInactiveException
classes.description: Thrown when a coupon is inactive or not valid at the current time.

classes.name: CurrencyMismatchException
classes.description: Thrown when there is a currency mismatch for a coupon, indicating the expected and actual currencies.

classes.name: InvalidApplyRequestException
classes.description: Thrown when an apply coupon request is invalid.

methods.name: <init>
methods.description: Constructors for each custom exception, initializing with specific message parameters.
